_what: What every connected account's card says in plain words (src/connection-card-words.mjs): what Trillion copies from it, what stays live with the person's own sign-in, and what Trillion may do with it. Each part is a list of rows read in order: the first row whose `when` facts all hold gives the sentence; `{name}` fills from the account's facts. A fact a row names is one of: shared, carried, arriving (the labels of the event sources listening to this service), local_copy, can_send, on (capabilities in use), off (capabilities turned off). A row with no `when` always holds. `also` rows add a sentence to the part above when their facts hold. `tool_server` is what a found tool server (MCP) row says before it is added (src/connector-screen.mjs). Changing what a card says is a change here, never in code.
tool_server: Runs live with your own sign-in when your AI asks; nothing from it is copied into Trillion ahead of time.

copied.say: Nothing. These are account details its owner shared; no data from the account is copied to you.
Nothing reaches Trillion's servers ahead of time. {service} stays on {account}, which keeps its own incoming copies.
Nothing is copied into Trillion ahead of time.

copied_also.say: Your computers with a key may keep a copy of this sign-in.

live.say: Nothing: shared details never let you use someone else's account.
Everything is reached live through {account} while it is awake.
Everything else is read live with this account's own sign-in when you or your AI ask.

allowed.say: Your AI may read and send with it.
Your AI may only read with it; it cannot send.
